info.title: FastMock Admin API
info.description: Manage stubs, inspect and verify the request journal, import API descriptions, record traffic and control chaos rules. All routes live on the admin listener under `/__admin` and need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors use `{"error": "...", "details": [...]}`.

get.description: Spaces, roles (with expanded permissions) and bindings of the access file (`FASTMOCK_ACCESS_FILE`), plus the global role of every static token written `name:role:hash` in `FASTMOCK_ADMIN_TOKENS` or `FASTMOCK_ADMIN_TOKENS_FILE` (`source: adminTokens`). Needs `access:read`, a global permission of the built-in admin role. Changes need a new access file or token list and a restart. Token values and hashes, file paths and OIDC settings are never included.

get.description: The identity provider redirects here. FastMock checks `state` (single use) and the login cookie, exchanges the code with the PKCE verifier, validates the ID token (signature, `iss`, `aud`, `azp`, `exp`, `iat`, `nonce`), reads the username and groups (falling back to userinfo for groups), and creates a session when the user has at least one binding. Success redirects to the `return` path with the session cookie; failure redirects to `/ui/?loginError=<code>` where code is `invalid_state`, `idp_error`, `failed`, `no_access` or `unavailable`.

404.description: SSO is not configured

get.summary: Sign-in methods for the login page
get.description: No authentication. Tells the UI whether SSO sign-in is configured.

No authentication. Redirects the browser to the identity provider (authorization code flow with `state`, `nonce` and PKCE S256) and sets a short-lived login cookie that ties the callback to this browser. The pending login is kept for 10 minutes in the shared hot store.

post.summary: End the SSO session
post.description: Deletes the session of the cookie and clears the cookie. Needs the `X-FastMock-Request: 1` header. When the provider has an `end_session_endpoint`, `logoutUrl` tells the UI where to send the browser to end the provider session too; it carries `client_id`, `post_logout_redirect_uri` and, when the session holds one, the sign-in's ID token as `id_token_hint`.

post.summary: Apply a Microcks APIExamples or APIMetadata document to an imported service
post.description: The service is found by `metadata.name` and `metadata.version`. APIExamples add example stubs (tag `<service tag>:examples`, replaced on re-import). APIMetadata adds labels and per-operation delay and dispatcher overrides; for OpenAPI services the stubs are regenerated with the overrides, which are kept across re-imports.

apiVersion: mocks.microcks.io/v1alpha1
kind: APIMetadata
metadata:
  name: API Pastry - 2.0
  version: 2.0.0
  labels: {team: pastry}
operations:
  'GET /pastry/{name}':
    delay: 100

put.summary: Replace the mail chaos rules of a space
put.description: Stores the rules of one area and starts their counters from zero. Rules are evaluated in order at their stage; the first rule whose match holds and that fires (after `every`, `probability` and `times`) decides. Stages before routing (`connect`, `tls`, `ehlo`) use the global area's rules; `auth` and `mail` the space named like the AUTH user (else global); `rcpt` the space of the recipient; `data` the spaces the message is routed to. Rules with stage `provider` apply to the provider HTTP APIs. Needs `mail:write`.

post.summary: Create a managed token
post.description: Returns the token value once. The caller needs `tokens:write` and every permission of the role in each requested scope (globally for `global: true`), so a token never holds more than its creator; a caller bound only to spaces cannot create global tokens. `spaces: ["*"]` grants the role in every space, including spaces added to the access file later: it needs `tokens:write` and every permission of the role globally or through the caller's own `*` grant (being bound to every current space one by one is not enough). Expiry is mandatory; a token created by a managed token expires no later than that token and is revoked with it.

AccessBinding.description: A binding: of the access file, or the global role of a static token.

spaces.description: Spaces the role is granted in: `["*"]` for every space; empty for a global binding.

source.description:
`accessFile` for a binding of the access file; `adminTokens` for the global role of a
static token written `name:role:hash` (subject `token:<name>`).

AccessRole.description: A built-in role or a custom role of the access file.

builtin.description: `viewer`, `editor` or `admin`; false for custom roles of the access file.

permissions.description: The role's permissions, with wildcards expanded.

AccessSpace.description: A space of the access file.

pathPrefixes.description: Data-plane path prefixes the space's stubs must stay under (empty: no restriction).

hosts.description: Hosts the space's stubs must match (empty: no restriction).

mailDomains.description: Mail domains whose captured messages go to the space (`*.domain` for subdomains).

AccessView.description:
The access configuration, read-only: spaces and roles of the access file, its bindings and
the global roles of static tokens.

oidc.description: OIDC sign-in or OIDC bearer tokens are enabled.

roles.description: Built-in roles first (viewer, editor, admin), then the custom roles sorted by name.

bindings.description:
Bindings of the access file in file order, then the roles of static tokens written
`name:role:hash` in entry order. Static tokens written `name::hash` have only their
access-file bindings.

serviceId.description: Catalog id of the imported or updated service (absent on a dry run).

role.description: Role names of the principal's bindings, comma-separated.

principalKind.description: `token`, `apiToken`, `user` or `anonymous`; absent on events recorded before it was kept.

space.description: Space the change applied to; absent for global changes.

tokenLogin.description: Sign-in with an admin token is always available.

ignoreExtraArrayItems.description:
equalToJson: an actual array may hold more items than the expected one (WireMock
`ignoreExtraElements`, MockServer `ONLY_MATCHING_FIELDS`).

oneOf.description:
JSONPath dialect: `rfc9535` (default) or `jayway` (WireMock: `=~`, `in`, `nin`, `length()`,
filters applied to objects).

A body matcher applied to each node selected by jsonPath or xpath; objects and arrays are matched as
their JSON text (WireMock `matchesJsonPath` with `equalToJson`, `matchesJsonSchema`, `equalToXml`).

space.description: Space of the stub that scheduled the callback.

ChaosAction.description:
What a firing rule does: optionally wait (`delay`), then one of `reply`, `disconnect` or
`providerError`, or continue normally after a delay alone.

disconnect.description: Close the connection without a reply.

providerError.description:
Stage `provider` only: the error the provider API answers with, in the provider's format
(for example `MessageRejected`, `rateLimit`, `invalidKey`).

ChaosCounters.description: How often a rule matched and fired since its rules were stored.

matched.description: Events that met stage and match.

fired.description: Times the rule fired (with `times`, attempts beyond it are counted too).

ChaosMatch.description:
Conditions of a rule, written with the stub string matchers; all given ones must hold. `rcptTo`
holds when one recipient matches (at `rcpt`: the recipient of that command).

oneOf.description: Stages `auth`, `mail`, `rcpt`, `data`; a session without AUTH has no user.

ChaosReply.description: An SMTP reply sent instead of the normal one.

enhanced.description: Enhanced status code whose class matches the code; default `<class>.0.0`.

detailsHidden.description:
True when request/response excerpts, message excerpts and error texts were removed because
the caller is a viewer.

space.description: Space the run was started in; absent in the global area.

name.description: `[A-Za-z0-9._@-]`, at most 128 characters; unique among active tokens and distinct from the static token names.

role.description: Built-in role (`viewer`, `editor`, `admin`) or a custom role of the access file.

spaces.description: Spaces the role is granted in, or `["*"]` (the only entry) for every space of the access file, including spaces added later. Set either `spaces` or `global: true`.

expiresInDays.description: Lifetime in days: 1 to `FASTMOCK_TOKENS_MAX_DAYS` (default 365); when omitted, 90 or `FASTMOCK_TOKENS_MAX_DAYS` when that is lower.

description.example: CI pipeline of the billing team

token.description: The token value (`fm_` and 64 hex digits). Returned only in this response: store it now.

required.description: On 403: the built-in role (for principals holding only global built-in roles) or the permission the request needs.

space.description: Space of the file; absent in the global area. `name` is relative to the space.

total.description: All matching entries in the scanned window (may exceed `requests.len()`).

GrantableRole.description: A role and the scopes in which the caller may grant it.

builtin.description: `viewer`, `editor` or `admin`; false for custom roles of the access file.

global.description: The caller may create global tokens with this role.

spaces.description: Spaces in which the caller may create tokens with this role.

allSpaces.description: The caller may create tokens with this role and `spaces: ["*"]` (every space, including spaces added later): it holds `tokens:write` and every permission of the role globally or through its own `*` grant, and the access file defines at least one space.

schema.description: GraphQL SDL. A `# microcksId: <name> : <version>` comment names the service.

examples.description: Optional Microcks APIExamples (YAML/JSON text or object) with examples per query or mutation.

tag.description: Tag for the generated stubs (default: the service id).

har.description: HAR 1.2 document as a JSON object or JSON text.

mimeTypes.description: Keep only entries whose response MIME type starts with one of these, e.g. `application/json`.

hosts.description: Keep only entries for these hosts.

captureHeaders.description: Response headers to keep besides content-type (sensitive ones are always dropped).

HeaderValues.description: One header value, or an array of values sent as separate header lines (for example `Set-Cookie`).

topicNaming.description:
Kafka topic names: `channel` (default, the channel address) or `microcks`
(`<service>-<version>-<channel>`, as Microcks publishes).

imported.description: Stubs saved (0 on a dry run).

removed.description: Stubs deleted because they carried the replaced tag.

stubs.description: The generated stubs, only on a dry run.

stubsLoaded.description: Loaded stubs the caller may read.

instanceId.description:
Random id of the answering server process, new on every start. A change tells clients such as the
operator that an in-memory server lost its stubs.

warnings.description:
Stored stubs the caller can read that break the rules of their space (outside its path prefixes or
hosts, or in a space the access file no longer defines), typically after the access file changed.
They stay stored; fix or delete them.

space.description: Space of the stub that matched; absent for unmatched requests and global stubs.

score.description: Share of the pattern's matchers that matched, 0..1.

loggedOut.description: A session was found and deleted.

logoutUrl.description: The provider's end-session URL; the UI navigates there to end the IdP session too.

rules.description: Evaluated in order; the first rule that fires wins. At most 100.

id.description: Letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-` (at most 64); `rule-<n>` (its position) when left out.

times.description: Fire at most this many times.

every.description: Fire only on every n-th matching event (the n-th, 2n-th, ...).

seed.description:
With `probability`: decide from the seed and the number of the matching event instead of at
random, so a run repeats.

space.description: The space; absent for the global area.

rules.description: The rules, each with its id.

counters.description: How often each rule matched and fired since the rules were stored, over all replicas.

document.description: An APIExamples or APIMetadata document (YAML/JSON text or object).

expectations.description: One expectation or an array of expectations.

MockServerImportBody.description: One expectation, an array of expectations, or the wrapper with `expectations`.

spec.description: OpenAPI 3 document as a JSON object or as JSON/YAML text.

spaces.description: Permissions granted only in single spaces, by space; the effective permissions in a space are these plus the global ones. Permissions granted through `spaces: ["*"]` appear under every configured space.

allSpaces.description: Permissions granted in every space through `spaces: ["*"]`, including spaces added to the access file later (empty when none).

collection.description: Postman Collection v2.1 (or v2.0) as a JSON object or JSON text.

role.description: The highest built-in role whose permissions the principal holds everywhere (`viewer` when it holds less); kept for older clients, decide with `permissions`.

groups.description: OIDC users: the group names from the identity provider (`kind: user` only).

captureHeaders.description: Response headers to keep in recorded stubs (content-type is always kept).

requestHeaders.description: Request headers to add as matchers.

headers.description: Header values: a string, or an array of strings sent as separate header lines.

space.description: Space of the scenario; absent in the global area.

matched.description: Number of patterns found in order.

requestIds.description: Journal ids of the requests that satisfied the patterns, in order.

captureHeaders.description: Request headers to add as `equalTo` matchers (sensitive ones become `matches: .+`).

repeatsAsScenarios.description: Turn repeated identical requests with different responses into a scenario.

persist.description: Save the stubs (default true); false only returns them.

tag.description: Tag added to every generated stub, next to `recorded`.

oneOf.description: Only entries matching this request pattern.

document.description: The SoapUI project XML (`/import/soapui`) or the WSDL 1.1 document (`/import/wsdl`).

tag.description: Tag for the generated stubs (default: the service id).

path.description: Endpoint path; default: the mock service path (SoapUI) or the port address path (WSDL).

mockService.description: SoapUI only: which mock service to import when the project has several.

pathPrefixes.description: Data-plane path prefixes the space's stubs must stay under (empty: no restriction).

hosts.description: Hosts the space's stubs must match (empty: no restriction).

mailDomains.description: Mail domains whose captured messages go to the space (`*.domain` for subdomains).

permissions.description: The caller's effective permissions in the space.

allValues.description:
Every value of a multi-valued parameter must match at least one of these matchers, and at least one
value must be present (MockServer `keyMatchStyle: MATCHING_KEY`).

order.description:
Tie-breaker between stubs of equal priority: the lower value is tried first. A stub with an `order`
is placed before stubs without one, and URL specificity is not used for it. Set by the WireMock
(newest wins) and MockServer (oldest wins) importers.

space.description:
Space the stub belongs to (see access control); absent for the global area. Set on create and never
changed afterwards.

TokenInfo.description: Metadata of a managed token; the value is never shown again after creation.

spaces.description: Spaces of the token: `["*"]` for every space; empty for a global token.

createdBy.description: Name of the principal that created the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Last use, recorded at most once per minute.

parentId.description:
The managed token that created this one; it expires no later than that token and is revoked
with it.

TokenOptions.description: What the caller may choose when creating a token.

roles.description:
Every role, built-in first, with the scopes where the caller may grant it (the escalation rule
applied to the caller).

TopicNaming.description:
How Kafka topics are named: after the channel (default) or as Microcks does,
`<service name without spaces and dashes>-<version>-<channel with / replaced by ->`.

exactly.description: Same as `count` (MockServer and WireMock wording); give only one of them.

requests.description: Patterns that must have been received in this order (other requests may come in between). 1..50.

gitSha.description: Commit the binary was built from, when the build set `FASTMOCK_GIT_SHA`.

features.description:
Compiled-in optional features and capabilities; with the mail module enabled also `mail`, and
`mail.imap`, `mail.pop3` (when their listeners are on) and `mail.providers`.

mappings.description: `{"mappings": [...]}`, an array of mappings or a single mapping.

bearer.description: Static admin token from FASTMOCK_ADMIN_TOKENS, a managed token from POST /__admin/tokens or, with FASTMOCK_OIDC_API_AUDIENCE, a JWT from the OIDC provider. The UI may instead use the SSO session cookie (see the `session` scheme). Every route needs a permission (`resource:action`); the built-in roles viewer, editor and admin are permission sets, custom roles and space bindings come from FASTMOCK_ACCESS_FILE. Without an access file: GET/HEAD and read-only POSTs need viewer, other changes editor; deleting all stubs, reset, the audit log and managing other tokens (`/__admin/tokens*`, `tokens:read`/`tokens:write`) and reading the access configuration (`/__admin/access`, `access:read`) need admin. Routes without a rule need admin.

session.name: __Host-fastmock_session
session.description: SSO session cookie set by GET /__admin/auth/callback; accepted by every /__admin route instead of a bearer token when no Authorization header is sent. Requests other than GET and HEAD need the `X-FastMock-Request: 1` header.
